skill.name: hybrid-search-implementation
skill.description: Implementation guide for combining vector similarity, keyword search, result fusion, and reranking in RAG and search applications.
skill.summary: Build hybrid search pipelines that combine semantic and exact-match retrieval.
skill.author: wshobson

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, search variable names, and documentation links. No prompt injection, credential access, or malicious execution intent was found. One semantic issue remains in the PostgreSQL metadata filter example, which can permit SQL injection if filter names are untrusted.

remediation.issue: Metadata filter keys are interpolated into SQL.
remediation.suggestion: Whitelist allowed metadata keys or use a JSONB containment query with fully parameterized values. Do not concatenate caller-supplied field names into SQL.

remediation.issue: Example code does not warn about unsafe dynamic filters.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short security note near the PostgreSQL template that filter keys must be validated before use.

semantic_findings.title: SQL Injection Risk in Metadata Filters
semantic_findings.description: The PostgreSQL template appends filter_metadata keys into a SQL predicate with string interpolation. If callers pass untrusted filter names, they can alter the SQL predicate despite parameterized values.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The value side is parameterized, but the metadata key is concatenated into where_clause and then inserted into the query. This is a clear injection path if filter names are user controlled.

content.value_statement: Single-mode search can miss exact terms or semantic matches. This skill provides hybrid search patterns that combine vector, keyword, fusion, and reranking methods.
actual_capabilities: Explains RRF, linear fusion, cross-encoder reranking, and cascade search patterns.
Provides Python templates for reciprocal rank fusion and score normalization.
Shows PostgreSQL hybrid search with pgvector and full-text search indexes.
Shows Elasticsearch hybrid search with dense vectors, BM25, and RRF ranking.
Outlines a custom async RAG pipeline with vector search, keyword search, fusion, and reranking.
limitations: Templates require adaptation before production use.
The skill does not include a packaged library or automated test suite.
The PostgreSQL filter example needs key validation before accepting user filters.
It does not choose embeddings, chunking, or evaluation datasets for you.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Hybrid Search Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hybrid-search-implementation skill to design a basic RAG search architecture for my corpus. Include vector search, keyword search, and fusion choices.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to adapt my PostgreSQL and pgvector schema for hybrid search. Include safe metadata filtering and index guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Retrieval Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare RRF, linear fusion, and reranking for my search results. Recommend metrics and tuning steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a production hybrid RAG pipeline with async retrieval, reranking, latency controls, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: I need better recall for product support RAG search.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend vector retrieval, keyword retrieval, RRF fusion, and optional cross-encoder reranking for high-value queries.

output_examples.input: My vector search misses product codes and names.
output_examples.output: The skill would add keyword search, tune vector and text weights, and log separate scores for evaluation.

output_examples.input: I want hybrid search in PostgreSQL.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline pgvector indexes, full-text indexes, RRF ranking, and safe handling for metadata filters.

best_practices: Evaluate fusion weights on representative queries before production use.
Log vector, keyword, fused, and rerank scores for debugging and tuning.
Validate filter fields and bounds before passing them into search templates.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on vector search alone when exact names, codes, or terms matter.
Do not concatenate user-controlled field names into SQL or search scripts.
Do not over-fetch candidates without measuring latency and ranking quality.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps design hybrid search systems that combine vector retrieval, keyword retrieval, fusion, and reranking.

faq.question: Does it include production-ready code?
faq.answer: It provides templates and patterns. You must adapt, test, and secure them for your application.

faq.question: Which databases does it cover?
faq.answer: It includes examples for PostgreSQL with pgvector and Elasticsearch with dense vectors.

faq.question: Can it improve RAG results?
faq.answer: Yes. Hybrid retrieval can improve recall when semantic search or keyword search alone misses relevant documents.

faq.question: Does it handle reranking?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes cross-encoder reranking examples and a custom RAG pipeline pattern.

faq.question: What should I secure before deployment?
faq.answer: Validate metadata filter keys, bound candidate counts, protect database access, and test queries against realistic data.
